description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Bamunakotuwa D/S Division, Welimada D/S Division for Water Supply Projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains two separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land) for water supply projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including their names, extents, boundaries, and claimants' information. While a minister is named and his portfolio is mentioned, the core subject matter is land acquisition for public projects, making this a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
